description: Create, or reuse, a secure payment page hosted by Stripe where the business owner pays for a KaiCalls plan from list_plans with their own card. Needs business_id, plan_id and an idempotency_key: retrying with the same key returns the same page, and choosing a different plan needs a new key. This tool charges nothing; only the owner can pay, by opening the page themselves. It never proves payment or that the phone line is live: get_checkout_status reports payment for the returned session_id.

business_id.description: The business the plan is for.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this checkout; reuse it when retrying.

name: create_checkout
title: Create or Resume Checkout
